package.description: Interactive terminal for AitherOS — chat with AI agents from your shell

en-US.description: Interactive terminal for AitherOS — chat with AI agents from your shell
en-US.longDescription:
AitherShell is an interactive terminal for AitherOS. Run `aither` for a REPL,
or `aither "message"` for a one-shot answer that prints and exits. Agents run
on your own hardware, a self-hosted fleet, or a cloud API — the same commands
either way.
en-US.name: AitherShell
